interpretation: Mixing priors alone is not an established explanation for poor transfer.
The combined checkpoint also changes the missing-value representation and disables feature grouping relative to the specialist checkpoints.
Matching inference settings leaves a substantial combined-versus-generic gap.
Context-only and joint context/query imputation improve Spearman; query-only imputation does not.
Category-code changes alone have negligible effect in the controlled test.
The original combined checkpoint predates the added query-column masking policy. Its benefit remains untested.
No further implementation bug was confirmed by this audit. These checks cannot exclude every bug.
